evidenceNotes: Starting measurement, October 11 at 2:51–2:53 AM Eastern: 31 public YouTube Shorts held 14,895 lifetime views; 33 Instagram Reels held 13,337 displayed lifetime views. These opening counters are not campaign gains.

The opening YouTube/Instagram measurement was about 23 minutes after campaign start; that gap and unmeasured posts remain unknown. TikTok is counted from its verified campaign-time creation. Paid-versus-organic attribution and unique audience size are not established.

At 5:18-5:19 AM Eastern, all 31 baseline YouTube Shorts and 33 Instagram Reels matched: +90 and +10 reported views since their opening counters. At 5:20 AM, TikTok Studio reported 196 cumulative video views on the post created at 3:09 AM during this campaign. The displayed 296 combines those distinct components; it is not 296 new views since the last update.
Revenue remains unknown until confirmed payment records are connected. A support click or enquiry is not a payment.

The operator made no purchases, ad buys or paid media-generation orders for this campaign: recorded new spend is $0. Existing equipment, subscriptions and historical promotions are outside this new-spend figure.
Seven finished videos have 14 confirmed cloud schedules: YouTube daily at noon Eastern October 11–17, and Instagram daily at 6 PM Eastern October 12–18. Scheduled does not yet mean published.
The 17-slot rule counts active plus scheduled platform posts. Historical posts stay public in the archive. Two newly published posts plus 14 scheduled posts use 16 slots; one remains available.
The previews are editorial selections, not measured winners. Performance highlights are selected after publication and a four-hour review, with later checks for delayed analytics.

Owned source discovery covers Twitch recordings, local OBS footage and a 12-page FACEIT library. Three FACEIT originals and recovered Twitch clips supplied this batch. Complete archive indexing remains in progress.

The opening edit is public on X and TikTok, verified in each native interface. Early native counters are available, but the first four-hour reviews are due around 7:10 AM Eastern on October 11; these releases are not measured performance winners.

The previous X analytics check at 4:19 AM Eastern showed two video views and one unique video viewer. These small counts may include operator verification and remain excluded from the displayed total; X post impressions are a separate metric.
